messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Pardiso
parts:
The only thing you need to do, is to register to get the license, with

inla.pardiso()

and follow the guideline for how to add the license.
the require libraries are already there, you just need to set to work
(Linux & Mac only for the moment)

please use R-4.2 and the most recent testing version, and add

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(inla.mode="experimental")
